accuracy.anchor: Only the dedupe cause and the affected count stated; no reproduction, no T+60 re-plan, no isolation audit, no profile evidence, no signature risk (anchor: 0–10 = two of seven points).

structure.anchor: Feature before incident; no evidence anywhere; the update ends on a question (anchor: 5–9 = parts missing).

customer_relevance.anchor: The auditor's constraint is deferred and the T+60 change is never acknowledged; widening the network breaks the envelope (anchor: 0–7 = customer outcome absent).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: All seven segments off target; twelve fillers in 8.1 minutes, two tag questions, two long pauses (anchor: 0–4 = most segments off, frequent fillers).

recovery.anchor: No objection held the pattern; every follow-up was needed and none produced evidence (anchor: 0–3 = conceded or deflected).

stems: "Customers are being charged twice; that goes first." — rank by cost before choosing the fun problem.
"I kept the constraint and did this instead…" — never widen a permission to get past a blocker; say what you did instead.
"You can re-run this without me: …" — give the auditor one command and one table.
